title: SWAMP — Playable Album
summary: A top-down frog action game where the music reacts to your gameplay. Each zone is a track. The game IS the album.

overview.what: A browser game where you play as a frog descending through a corrupted swamp. The music has layers that intensify with combat. Zone 1 (Surface Pond) and Zone 2 (The Bog rave cantina) are built. Includes DOOM first-person mode and Hextris-style hex puzzle as minigames.
overview.status_detail: Playable prototype deployed. Core mechanics working: tongue whip, belly flop, NPC dialogue with choices, zone transitions, gate/toll system, touch controls for mobile.

columns.name: Show friend the prototype
values: Send him the link + pitch the concept
Text him the GitHub Pages link and explain the vision

values: Friend produces 1 demo track with layerable stems

values: Better music, more polish, bug fixes

columns.name: Build Zone 3 & 4
values: Design after Zone 1-2 are polished and friend has music direction

considerations.label: Core mechanic
considerations.detail: Adaptive music — layers fade in/out based on combat intensity. Kills raise intensity, idle lowers it.

considerations.label: Friend's role
considerations.detail: Music production. He plays metal but is versatile. Needs to hear the prototype to understand the vision.

considerations.label: Content play
considerations.detail: Gameplay clips + music = TikTok/YouTube content. Sploinky/frogcore aesthetic is trending.

notes:
The key blocker is getting the friend on board. Everything else follows from that. Send him the prototype, let him play it, then discuss music direction.

The game has 3 modes:
1. Top-down exploration (walk, talk to NPCs, catch bugs)
2. DOOM first-person (eat a Voidfly from Shaman Gorp)
3. Hex puzzle (talk to Oracle Shell)

Zone progression: Surface Pond → The Bog (frog rave) → The Undergrowth → The Depths
